extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology record; removes placeholder nucleic-acid/cell-wall claims and preserves only directly assayed membrane/cell-viability mechanisms plus structural support.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: LHH1 damages the S. aureus membrane, supported by lipid-vesicle leakage, FITC binding, SEM morphology, and PI uptake assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper supports membrane damage/permeabilization; it does not prove a specific molecular receptor or cell-wall biosynthesis target.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: LHH1 against MGC803, HCT116, and C666-1 cells
mechanism_claims.claim_text: LHH1 binds/penetrates cancer-cell membranes and is associated with concentration-dependent late apoptosis in the tested cancer cell lines.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The source supports membrane association and apoptosis readouts, but not a unique intracellular target pathway.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD data show high alpha-helical content in membrane-mimetic solvents, providing structural context for membrane activity.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural context supports but does not independently prove mechanism.
